title: what landed, from 11 merged changes

prompt:
Summarise what these merged changes did. One bullet per distinct piece of work, at most eight bullets. Cite the ticket identifier for every bullet. Use only identifiers that appear in the list below; if you are unsure of an identifier, leave it out rather than guessing at one.

9ee2dd3 omnimarket#3704: ci(OMN-20074): rebase core topic hook onto dev
    Source no-hardcoded-topics from omnibase_core with its exclude and settings unchanged. Preserve dev's emitter AC4 and deploy-gate AC5, and append the topic-hook requirement and evidence binding as AC6.
cc1b5fe omnimarket#3725: feat(OMN-19514): a completed ticketed delegation asks dod_verify to verify its ticket, naming the run

4f43af4 omnimarket#3740: feat(OMN-20604): lab job check schedule compute and check effect (supervisor M4)
    * feat(OMN-20604): add lab job check schedule and effect
6f690c1 omnimarket#3769: feat(OMN-20674): register node_morning_friction_sweep_orchestrator
    Adds the onex.nodes entry point node_morning_friction_sweep_orchestrator = omnimarket.nodes.node_morning_friction_sweep_orchestrator to pyproject.toml.
5154d09 omnimarket#3766: feat(OMN-20673): the morning node reads the PR watcher snapshot for its open-PR census
    * feat(OMN-20673): add bounded PR watcher snapshot to ground state
21bcdb1 omnimarket#3765: feat(OMN-20913): onex scm, one lane entry point over the source-control nodes
    Adds `onex scm <verb>` registered in pyproject [project.entry-points."onex.cli"] as scm = "omnimarket.handlers.scm.scm_cli:scm_group".
c254c4d omnimarket#3538: feat(OMN-16294): worktree lease node refuses a second lane in a held worktree
    * feat(OMN-16294): worktree lease node refuses a second lane in a held worktree
7c76b81 omnimarket#3753: feat(OMN-20949): kafka_boundaries.yaml ships beside node_duplication_sweep and D2 reads it there
    * feat(OMN-20949): kafka_boundaries.yaml ships beside node_duplication_sweep and D2 reads it there
1371eb1 omnimarket#3748: feat(OMN-20867): a lane's private overlay sets whether its landing orchestrator and red triage act
    * feat(OMN-20867): allow lane overlay to set act flags via env refs
ef49ed6 omnimarket#3745: feat(OMN-20905): operator decisions and asks are recorded from the bus by a consumer node, not by hooks
    * feat(OMN-20905): operator decisions and asks are recorded from the bus by a consumer node, not by hooks
d999706 omnimarket#3767: fix(OMN-20074): Replace I9 prompt with code task, add Layer-1 test, AC7
